summary: Nez Perce NF two-story log cupola cabin, built about 1930 and abandoned in 1950; firelookout.com and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page list it as gone, and no source describes what remains.

facts.design: Two-story log cabin with a cupola
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.com and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

access.note: Tagged drive-up by the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, on Nez Perce National Forest land. None of the four sources mentions a closure or a permit.

visit.trail_note: The Idaho Fire Lookouts page tags the site Drive-Up. The cabin is gone, so there is nothing to climb; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: The four sources agree on the date (about 1930) and the 1950 abandonment. Three (firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts Idaho County page and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page) describe the two-story log cupola form, which the Forest Service list does not give. Two (firelookout.com and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page) list the site as gone. No source describes the site today, and the story says so. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it has no documented staffing history, so staffing is omitted. Access 'public' rests on the drive-up tag and national forest land, with no closure in the sources. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced. The brief's kind 'two_story' matches the sources.
